description: Resolve circular import dependencies in a Node.js project. Three files have a circular dependency: validation.js imports from formatting.js, formatting.js imports from database.js, and database.js imports from validation.js, creating a cycle. The application crashes on startup with 'TypeError: Cannot read property of undefined'. Break the cycle by refactoring the code. You can either: (A) Extract the shared errorPrefix constant to constants.js and update imports, (B) Use lazy imports (require inside functions), or (C) Pass dependencies as parameters. Files are located in /home/ga/workspace/api-project/src/. Ensure the application can load successfully (node index.js should not crash) and no circular dependencies remain.
